comparison.objective: Refit a window insect screen into its four-sided frame and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually orient a large frame, compress plungers, and seat all edges into channels.
comparison.success_condition: Screen fitted on all sides, plungers bearing, stable, undamaged, and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Despite the word “screen,” this tests large-frame installation, not use of a perforated tool to separate media from workpieces.
